boundElsewhere: That Discord server is already linked to another Twitch channel. Ask that channel's owner to open this server in Bagel, go to Settings and choose Disconnect. Then add it here again.
conflict: Someone else saved this server first. Reload and try again.
forbidden: Discord refused that because Bagel is missing a permission in this server. In Discord, open Server Settings, then Roles, and drag Bagel's role above the roles it manages. If you unchecked a permission when adding Bagel, choose Re-authorize on this server's Settings page, then choose Add Bagel again next to this server and keep every permission checked.
invalid: Some settings were not valid, so they were left as they were.
invalidFields: Saved, but these were left as they were: {fields}.
locked: Discord is in beta and open to Premium channels only.
noGuilds: Discord did not list a server you can add a bot to. You need to own the server, or have Manage Server on it.
notBound: No Discord server is connected yet.
oauth: Discord did not return a server. Try adding Bagel again.
rateLimited: Discord is rate limiting us. Try again in a minute.
setup: Could not save the connected server. Try again.
state: That Discord link expired. Start from Add Bagel again.
ticketsOff: Turn the ticket desk on before reposting the panel.
unavailable: Discord did not answer. Try again in a moment.
timeout: This took too long. Some of it may be missing; reload to see the rest.
notFound: That channel or role is gone from the server. Pick another one.
unknown: Something went wrong on our side. Try again, and tell support if it keeps happening.
unconfigured: Discord is not configured on this deployment (missing client id or redirect).
declined: You cancelled on Discord's screen, so nothing was added. Choose Add a server to try again.
